title: Mia's Growing Treasure
moral: Treasure grows when shared with others.

scenes.summary: Mia finds a map and begins a treasure hunt.
scenes.text: Mia finds a tiny bottle with a map and starts a treasure hunt with her mommy.
scenes.image_prompt: little girl holding bottle map garden cartoon style

scenes.summary: They solve a puzzle to find the key.
scenes.text: Mia and her mommy use a scale to figure out how to get the key.
scenes.image_prompt: child using scale puzzle garden cartoon style

scenes.summary: They follow clues to a fountain.

scenes.summary: They find and open the treasure box.

scenes.summary: Mia shares the treasure with others.

story: Mia finds a tiny bottle with a map and starts a treasure hunt with her mommy. Mia and her mommy use a scale to figure out how to get the key. They follow red dots and sounds of water to reach the next treasure location. They open a box filled with small treasures and a message about sharing. Mia shares the treasures with her family and friends and feels happy.
